resources.string:
Phase 0 tests with the back camera, without a preview.

One test photo: the camera opens, waits 5 s for the exposure, focuses once, takes one photo and closes.

Speed test (about 3 minutes): photos one after the other at 4 sizes, photos from preview frames, and 10 s videos at 15 and 5 frames per second.

Tap a button, then switch the screen off with the power button. The camera starts %1$d s after the tap, so you can check that it works with the screen off.

Photos, videos and the log are saved in:
%2$s
Working: the camera starts %1$d s after the tap and closes again when the test ends.
FaunaLapse needs the camera permission to take photos. Tap the button again to allow it.
FaunaLapse is running a camera test
The camera closes again when the test ends.
